en.summary: Importing offline packages is faster and shows its progress throughout.
changes: Offline packages are checked once, while they are unpacked. Importing a package again, Checking packages before installing and the first start no longer read every file again.
The Working card shows which package is being imported and how far it is; Checking packages and Verify local files show their progress as well.
After the Environment package is imported, the model step no longer asks for it again.

zh.summary: 离线包导入更快，全程都能看到进度。
changes: 离线包只在解压时校验一次；再次导入同一个包、安装前「检查配套包」和首次启动都不再把所有文件重读一遍。
左侧「正在处理」卡片会显示正在导入第几个包和进度；「检查配套包」和「校验本地文件」也有进度条。
导入运行环境包后，模型这一步不再提示还需要运行环境包。
